media.title: Little Boy Blue (1936) — film poster
media.description: Promotional poster for Little Boy Blue (1936), an animated short represented in the Kaper database as Work W-F052 / Film F052. The image is sourced from Wikimedia Commons and has been treated as public domain in the United States under the pre-1978 no-notice rationale recorded there.
media.altText: Promotional poster for the animated short Little Boy Blue (1936).
media.rightsNote: Wikimedia Commons marks this poster as public domain in the United States: published in the United States between 1931 and 1977 without a copyright notice; the file page also records a no-notice/no-registration rationale. Commons notes that copyright may still subsist in some non-US jurisdictions.
media.publicCaption: Poster for Little Boy Blue (Celebrity Productions / P. A. Powers, 1936).
media.publicImageText: The image shows a colorful poster for Little Boy Blue, with the film title and animation-series branding.
